name: THE BURRITO STAND-%
source_address: 937 E NORTH ST BSMT 501, Rapid City

violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. -Bag of beans on floor in commissary kitchen...parked at commissary kitchen.
Sanitizing solution testing devices. — --Test strip or kit that accurately measures the sanitizing concentration was not provided. -Need for bleach.
Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. -Items stored on floor in commissary.
Mobile food service establishment. — --Need to have a food safe hose to fill food truck water tank.
